newsitem.title: UK: Three April Brent cargoes kept - trade.
newsitem.headline: Three April Brent cargoes kept - trade.

text.p: Three Brent cargoes nominated from the April programme on Friday were kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
Two cargoes, due to load April 20-22 and April 21-23, were kept by trader Arcadia while the third, loading April 20-22, was kept by British Petroleum, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
